title: Quarterly options expiration — triple witching (December 2027), five sessions before the Conference Board's December print
source: EST: the standard third-Friday rule applied forward, not a fetched 2027 exchange calendar. December 2027's Fridays are the 3rd, 10th, 17th, 24th and 31st, so the third Friday is 2027-12-17. The rule was verified against this calendar's own tracked entries rather than assumed: opex-2026-12-18 (Fridays 4/11/18/25 -> third is the 18th), opex-2026-11-20 (6/13/20/27 -> 20th) and the opex-2027-01-15, opex-2027-05-21, opex-2027-09-17 and opex-2027-10-15 proposals all resolve to their month's third Friday. Filed estimate because no 2027 exchange expiration calendar was fetched -- the egress proxy blocks nyse.com and nasdaqtrader.com from this lane's runner -- and because a quarterly triple-witching date is an exchange fact this lane may not self-confirm. Note the 2027-12-24 configuration when reading the corridor: Christmas Day 2027 is a Saturday, so the following Friday is a full closure and this expiration is the LAST full Friday session of the year. Discovered during the consumer-confidence-2027-12-22 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: DISCOVERED during the consumer-confidence-2027-12-22 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-08). PROPOSED BECAUSE IT IS THE ONLY OTHER DATED EVENT INSIDE THE PROPOSER'S FIVE-DAY CORRIDOR: before this PR the calendar held ZERO tracked events anywhere in December 2027 except the fomc-2027-12-08 and fhfa-hpi-2027-12-28 proposals, neither of which is within five days of 2027-12-22. TWO CAUTIONS FOR WHOEVER TAKES THIS. (1) THE PROPOSER'S OWN CORRIDOR FINDING IS MARGINAL AND SHOULD NOT BE INHERITED AS A PREMISE. Sessions between the December Conference Board print and year-end read 8 of 9 narrower than the tape on a per-session Mann-Whitney, and survive removing the half sessions -- but a block-permutation test over the same five contiguous blocks returns p=0.0575, so the compression is not established. This expiration sits BEFORE that corridor opens, so nothing in it transfers here either way. (2) DECEMBER TRIPLE WITCHING IS THE ONE EXPIRATION THAT ALSO CARRIES ANNUAL INDEX RECONSTITUTION FLOW in some index families; this lane did not research that and makes no claim about it. The proposer's channel work is about range compression in the holiday week, not about expiration mechanics, and a taking lane should treat this file as a date and a corridor position only. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
